rules.backup_simple: Where today's matcher leaves a sale or listing unmatched, attach it only when the title (or a Funko Pop category) has Funko and Pop, the box number, and the full character name. Today's match is kept when the two disagree. Chase, finish, and size must agree. Catalog finish or colour the title lacks, and ask-only exclusive-or-several-row cases, go to review and are not counted. Asks are never sold.
rules.outlier: n>=4: keep within [med/3, med*3]; n==1 dropped if >10x ask median (ask n>=3)
rules.mover: med30 vs prior 31-365d, n>=5 each side
rules.mover_bimodal: null if either window max/min>3 or IQR/median>0.6
rules.chase_route: CHASE title -> Chase row only from tier=standard sources, and only if same license AND source base-name tokens (finish/chase words stripped) are a subset of the target name, else excluded
rules.buy: sold sample not two-group (max/min<=3, IQR/median<=0.6); variant/exclusive tokens must match Pop; conf asks only, sold_n>=5, 0.25<=ratio<=0.70, newest conf ask <=180d, conf ask median >=50% of sold median (mismatch guard), box number shared by <30 Pops
rules.conf_ask: conf=true from matcher AND condition New AND first 2 name words in title AND chase rows need CHASE in title AND no variant-word clash (glow/diamond/black light/B&W/etc. not in Pop name); accessory listings (PopShield/protector/pin/keychain) excluded
rules.ambiguous_box: movers/buy suppressed when box blank or shared by >=30 Pops
